description: Unit tests for rbus element handling, including creation, retrieval, insertion, deletion, and printing of elements and rows within a hierarchical structure, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: isElementValid
methods.description: Checks if the element's fullName matches the expected full name.

methods.name: testRetrieveElement
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an element by query and compares its fullName to expected.

methods.name: testRetrieveInstanceElement
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an instance element by query and compares its fullName to expected.

methods.name: insertElem
methods.description: Inserts an element at a specified path with a given type into the hierarchy.

methods.name: removeElem
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified path from the hierarchy.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Adds a new row (instance) to a table element.

methods.name: delRow
methods.description: Deletes a row (instance) from a table element.

methods.name: printRow
methods.description: Prints all registered elements in the hierarchy.
